jobs.description:
🇩🇰 ER DU VORES NYE MEDARBEJDER?

Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt!

RenTid søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent til en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen med mulighed for merarbejde.

Læs og forstå hele opslaget, før du ansøger. Vi forventer, at du har læst og forstået opslaget, inden du søger stillingen. Ansøgninger fra personer, der ikke opfylder de grundlæggende krav i opslaget, vil ikke komme i betragtning.

RenTid er en virksomhed i vækst, og vi søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent, som er dygtig til sit håndværk og har lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os. Hos RenTid spiller øje for et perfekt resultat og sans for detaljen en stor rolle.

Du bliver ansat som rengøringsassistent og skal først og fremmest levere rengøring af høj kvalitet hos vores kunder i Aarhus og omegn.

Vi ser ikke kun på dit CV – vi ser på din arbejdsmoral, ansvarlighed, kvalitet og lyst til at udvikle dig.

🇩🇰 🚀 MULIGHED FOR UDVIKLING

Når RenTid vokser, opstår der nye muligheder. Den rette medarbejder kan med tiden få ansvar for eksempelvis:

• 
Kvalitetskontrol

• 
Oplæring af nye medarbejdere

• 
Kundekontakt

• 
Koordinering og planlægning

• 
Teamlederfunktioner

• 
Større driftsansvar

Hvor langt du kan komme, afhænger i høj grad af dig.

🇩🇰 🧹 VI FORVENTER, AT DU:

• 
Har solid erfaring med rengøring i private hjem.

• 
Ikke er bange for at arbejde alene.

• 
Gerne har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring.

• 
Arbejder selvstændigt og grundigt, men også kan fungere i mindre teams.

• 
Har øje for detaljer og kvalitet.

• 
Er mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst.

• 
Har en positiv indstilling og tager imod feedback.

• 
Har kørekort B og ikke er bange for at køre bil er et "Must". Du skal ikke søge stillingen, hvis du ikke har kørekort og lyst til at køre bil.

• 
Selv kan komme til og fra arbejdspladsen i Aarhus.

• 
Er indstillet på, at der kan forekomme weekendarbejde. Kan du ikke arbejde i weekenderne, så er RenTid ikke stedet for dig.

🇬🇧 SPROG – VIGTIGT

Du skal kunne tale, forstå, læse og skrive flydende engelsk.

Du skal ikke søge stillingen, hvis du ikke taler og forstår engelsk.

Dansk er en klar fordel, men ikke et krav.

⏱️ PRØVEPERIODE

De første 3 måneder er en prøveperiode efter gældende danske regler.

Her vurderer vi blandt andet din arbejdsindsats, kvalitet, samarbejde, ansvarlighed og udvikling.

💰 LØN OG MULIGHEDER

Du får en god og ordentlig løn fra starten.

Din startløn vil være 145,00 kr. pr. time, plus 12,5 % feriepenge og ATP efter gældende regler.

Større ansvar, højere løn og andre goder følger med, når du viser, at du kan løfte mere.

Efter de 3 måneders prøvetid har du mulighed for at genforhandle din løn ud fra de kvalifikationer og den udvikling, du har vist os i løbet af prøveperioden.

Vi leder efter en person, der ikke bare søger et job – men gerne vil være en del af RenTids udvikling.

📍 ARBEJDSOMRÅDE

Aarhus og omegn.

RenTid stiller bil til rådighed for dig eller teamet i arbejdstiden.

📩 LYDER DET SOM DIG?

Send os en motiveret ansøgning og CV med billede.

Fortæl kort om:

• 
Dig selv

• 
Din erfaring med rengøring

• 
Din erfaring med private hjem

• 
Eventuel erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

• 
Hvad du gerne vil udvikle dig inden for

Ansøgningen skal være på engelsk.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

🇬🇧 ARE YOU OUR NEW EMPLOYEE?

Start date: As soon as possible!

RenTid is looking for an experienced cleaning assistant for a full-time position of 37 hours per week, with the possibility of additional hours.

Please read and understand the entire job advertisement before applying. We expect you to have read and understood the advertisement before applying for the position. Applications from candidates who do not meet the basic requirements will not be considered.

RenTid is a growing company, and we are looking for an experienced cleaning assistant who is skilled at their workand motivated to develop and grow with us. At RenTid, attention to detail and delivering a perfect result are extremely important.

You will be employed as a cleaning assistant, and your primary responsibility will be to provide high-quality cleaningfor our customers in Aarhus and the surrounding area.

We do not only look at your CV – we look at your work ethic, responsibility, quality of work and willingness to develop.

🚀 OPPORTUNITIES FOR DEVELOPMENT

As RenTid grows, new opportunities will arise. The right employee may, over time, take on responsibility for areas such as:

• 
Quality control

• 
Training new employees

• 
Customer contact

• 
Coordination and planning

• 
Team leader responsibilities

• 
Greater operational responsibility

How far you can go depends largely on you.

🧹 WE EXPECT YOU TO:

• 
Have solid experience in residential cleaning.

• 
Not be afraid of working independently.

• 
Preferably have experience with commercial cleaning.

• 
Be able to work independently and thoroughly, while also being comfortable working in small teams.

• 
Have a strong eye for detail and quality.

• 
Be reliable, flexible and responsible.

• 
Have a positive attitude and be open to feedback.

• 
Have a valid Category B driving licence and be comfortable driving a car – this is a MUST. Please do not apply if you do not have a driving licence or are not willing to drive.

• 
Be able to get to and from the workplace in Aarhus independently.

• 
Be prepared for occasional weekend work. If you are unable to work weekends, RenTid is not the right place for you.

🇬🇧 LANGUAGE – IMPORTANT

You must be able to speak, understand, read and write fluent English.

Please do not apply if you do not speak and understand English.

Danish is a clear advantage, but not a requirement.

⏱️ PROBATIONARY PERIOD

The first 3 months will be a probationary period in accordance with applicable Danish rules.

During this period, we will evaluate your work performance, quality, cooperation, responsibility and development.

💰 SALARY AND OPPORTUNITIES

You will receive a fair and competitive salary from the beginning.

Your starting salary will be DKK 145.00 per hour, plus 12.5% holiday pay and ATP in accordance with applicable Danish rules.

Greater responsibility, higher pay and other benefits will follow as you demonstrate that you are capable of taking on more responsibility.

After the 3-month probationary period, you will have the opportunity to renegotiate your salary based on the qualifications and development you have demonstrated during the probationary period.

We are looking for someone who is not just looking for a job – but someone who wants to become part of RenTid’s continued development.

📍 WORK AREA

Aarhus and surrounding areas.

RenTid provides a company car for you or the team during working hours.

📩 DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?

Send us a motivated application and CV with a photo.

Please briefly tell us about:

• 
Yourself

• 
Your experience in cleaning

• 
Your experience with residential cleaning

• 
Any experience with commercial cleaning

• 
What areas you would like to develop your skills in

Your application must be written in English.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

Sky‑Watch A/S is a leading Danish drone company that since 2009 has specialized in the development, production, and servicing of high‑technology mini UAS systems for Defense – nationally and internationally. With more than 155+ dedicated employees and a strong international growth journey underway, Sky‑Watch today stands as one of the most innovative players within tactical mini UAV systems. At Sky‑Watch, robust, reliable, and advanced drone systems are developed for demanding environments and critical situations where predictability, mechanical durability, traceability and user safety are paramount.

As an ambitious scale-up company in rapid development, Sky-Watch continues to expand across products, markets and the organization.

To support the company’s international growth and further strengthen the strategic level of its marketing function, we are now looking for an ambitious, strategic and inspiring

Director of Marketing

Strategic Marketing Leadership – International Defense – Commercial Impact

Do you want to shape the marketing direction of a fast-growing high-tech defense company? As Director of Marketing at Sky-Watch, you will lead and develop the marketing function across Product Marketing & Strategy, Field & Event Marketing, and Brand & Digital Influence. You will strengthen the strategic level of marketing, set clear priorities and create the framework for a multidisciplinary team of specialists to succeed. At the same time, you will connect Sky-Watch’s advanced engineering capabilities with customer needs and government procurement requirements, strengthening the company’s positioning and commercial impact in international defense markets.

Working closely with Sales, Business Development and R&D, you will ensure that marketing supports strategic procurement programs, priority accounts and Sky-Watch’s international growth ambitions.

You will report to the VP Marketing and lead a marketing team of five.

Your key responsibilities include:

• 
Product Marketing & Strategy – positioning, go-to-market strategies, technical narratives, CONOPS and tender enablement.

• 
Field & Event Marketing – international defense exhibitions, live demonstrations and targeted market activities.

• 
Visual Brand Design & Digital Influence – compelling visual communication, digital narratives and consistent brand positioning.

• 
ABM & Partner Enablement – targeted initiatives towards priority accounts, procurement programs and international partners.

• 
People Leadership – develop the marketing team and create clear direction, collaboration and ownership.

To succeed in this role, you have around 10 years of experience within Marketing and Product Marketing in international high-tech companies, preferably within a regulated industry such as aerospace or defense, combined with a few years of leadership experience. You know how to set strategic direction while empowering specialists to take ownership of execution. You bring experience with Account-Based Marketing, lead generation and partner enablement and understand customer acquisition in public tender-driven markets. Experience with technical product marketing, Tier-1 accounts, international exhibitions and complex hardware and software portfolios will be important in the role, and a strong technical understanding or flair is considered an advantage.

You are based within reasonable commuting distance of Sky-Watch’s location in Støvring or Valby.

As a person, you are a strategic and results-oriented leader with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to translate strategy into execution. You provide clear direction while giving specialists the trust and autonomy to excel within their areas of expertise. You combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent communication and interpersonal capabilities. You are curious, adaptable and resilient in a dynamic scale-up environment and bring a collaborative and inclusive approach to leadership. With high accountability, integrity and professionalism, you are motivated by building a strong and high-performing marketing function.

Are you the new Director of Marketing at Sky-Watch? If so, please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity or religion. For further information about the position, please contact consultant Martin Tveit, Sensu A/S, by phone at +45 26 83 38 42.

For more information about Sky‑Watch, please visit www.sky-watch.com.

Please note that applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and no application deadline is set.

FirePoint Rocket Technology is building one of the most unique and strategically important industrial projects in Denmark - a new production facility for solid rocket propellant and advanced defense-tech components. Our ambition is significant: we are scaling from the early operational phase to 200+ employees within the next 18 months.

It is a Danish-based defense technology company, part of the international Fire Point Group — a fast-growing ecosystem born out of Ukraine’s innovation and resilience. The group was founded by engineers and entrepreneurs who, during the first months of the full-scale war, decided to use their expertise to create advanced defense technologies — including long-range drones and precision systems.

Joining FPRT now means becoming part of the core team shaping a new high-tech, safety-critical production environment from the ground up.

They are looking for a Maintenance & Engineering Manager who will establish and execute an absolute, zero-compromise reliability strategy from day one.

The Role

As the Maintenance & Engineering Manager, you are responsible for the operational integrity, availability, and safety of all production assets and process equipment. Manufacturing rocket propellant leaves no room for trial and error—our process equipment must be predictable, fully mastered down to the individual component, and maintained at peak condition.

Reporting directly to the Chief Production Officer (CPO), you will lead the technical team in deep equipment mastery, anticipating service intervals with precision, and proactively replacing high-risk components before failures occur. You will work in close functional alignment with Process Engineering, Manufacturing Automation, EHS, Quality, and Production Planning to ensure seamless, compliant operations.

What You Will Do

1. Production Maintenance Strategy & Asset Management

• Develop and implement a preventive and predictive maintenance strategy for all production equipment, focusing on long-cycle and batch-based processes (mixers, thermal curing ovens, polymerization, climate-controlled chambers) to ensure thermal stability and high uptime.

• Minimize downtime by transitioning from reactive repairs to condition-based monitoring and planned interventions.

• Lead the selection, implementation, and management of a CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) to track work orders, asset history, and maintenance costs.

• Integrate maintenance requirements into the equipment acquisition process alongside QA, establishing preventive risk assessments and managing obsolescence planning.

2. Process Utilities & Production Support Engineering

• Oversee point-of-use process utilities directly feeding production lines, such as process vacuum, specialized process gas loops, and line-dedicated thermal fluids.

• Coordinate with internal and external facility teams on utility drop interfaces to ensure production machinery interface readiness.

3. EHS & Process Safety Compliance

• Enforce strict adherence to EHS standards across all equipment maintenance activities.

• Rigorously execute Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures and "Permit to Work" systems on energetic material processing machinery and hazardous equipment zones.

4. Production Spare Parts & Technical Inventory

• Define critical spare parts strategies for production machinery to balance inventory costs with operational risk mitigation.

• Partner with the Warehouse team to track, store, and preserve technical production spares correctly.

• Monitor market lifecycle status for key equipment components and execute end-of-life obsolescence planning.

5. Team Leadership & Technical Development

• Lead, mentor, and schedule a team of production maintenance technicians and equipment specialists.

• Ensure the team is fully trained in safety protocols (ATEX, energetic materials) and advanced technical troubleshooting.

• Plan technician resources and build mechanical redundancy strategies to protect production during interventions or unplanned events.

6. Production Line CapEx & Commissioning Support

• Support the installation, mechanical integration, and commissioning of new production lines with Process Engineering and Automation.

• Provide early input on machine "serviceability and accessibility" during the design phase to eliminate future shop-floor bottlenecks.

First 90 Days – Expected Outcomes

• Critical spare parts inventory analysis completed and gaps identified.

• Preventative Maintenance (PM) schedule established for all key production assets.

• Maintenance team skills matrix assessed and training plan initiated.

• Design of the “obtain equipment” process and equipment lifecycle framework completed in collaboration with QA.

What We Offer

• A rare career opportunity to lead the engineering and maintenance function for one of Denmark's most unique industrial and defense-tech projects.

• A role where your technical expertise directly determines the reliability and safety of high-stakes, safety-critical production.

• A professional, international environment with a clear mission and purpose.

• Brand-new factory & equipment.

• Real authority, Greenfield impact, Zero toxic culture, Mastery over busywork.

• Top-of-market compensation for the right experience.

We Are Looking For

You are a highly structured, disciplined, and hands-on leader who thrives on the shop floor and maintains an absolute zero-compromise approach to equipment safety and operational reliability.

Requirements:

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Marine Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Experience: 5+ years of maintenance management experience within heavy industry, chemical processing, pharma, defense, or similar high-safety manufacturing environments.

• Leadership: Proven track record of managing technical teams, scheduling resources, and coordinating external contractors and facility service providers.

• Regulatory Knowledge: Experience working in highly regulated environments (ATEX, SEVESO, or similar energetic/hazardous contexts).

• Systems & Methods: Experience implementing or optimizing CMMS systems (e.g., SAP PM, Maximo) and utilizing OEE and Root Cause Analysis (FMEA, 8D, 5 Whys).

• Technical Mastery: Strong working knowledge of mechanical systems (hydraulics, pneumatics, rotating equipment), electrical systems, and industrial automation (PLC, SCADA).

Apply

If you think you are the right person for the job, then send us your CV and a job application. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

Due to GDPR rules we are not allowed to receive CV or application through our email system.

Temp-Team A/S is a national recruitment and staffing agency with eight local departments in Denmark. We have 45 years of experience within staffing and cover a wide range of industries. We focus on delivering high quality and a close personal contact to candidates and clients.

Temp-Team is a part of JuhlerGroup – an international group of recruitment agencies.

Are you an experienced Talent Acquisition (TA) professional with a strong track record in recruitment and proactive sourcing? Do you enjoy advising hiring managers, navigating challenging talent markets and finding specialist talent that is hard to reach? Would you like to help shape TA in a growing, international technology company?

Trackman is looking for an experienced TA Specialist to join our HR team at our headquarters in Hørsholm. TA is a newly established dedicated function within HR at Trackman. We are a small and collaborative team with responsibility for recruitment across the organisation.

Because we are a small team, everyone plays an important role. You will have a high degree of ownership and independence while working closely with your TA colleagues and the wider HR team. We are looking for someone who brings solid experience, can confidently run recruitment processes and sourcing activities independently, and is ready to contribute with ideas and best practices from day one.

You will join us at an exciting stage where we are continuing to develop our TA function, strengthen our sourcing capabilities and build more scalable ways of working. We value openness, collaboration and a good sense of humour. We help each other, share knowledge and ideas, and trust each other to take ownership.

What you will be doing

You will take ownership of recruitment processes and partner closely with hiring managers across the recruitment lifecycle, with a particular focus on identifying and engaging talent for specialist and hard-to-fill positions.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Drive recruitment processes in close collaboration with hiring managers, advising on candidate profiles, recruitment strategy, processes and market conditions.

• 
Proactively source and engage talent through LinkedIn Recruiter and other relevant channels.

• 
Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical profiles.

•

Location: On-site with possibility to work remote

Team: Data & AI

Seniority: Mid-Level to Senior

**About The Platform

**Our team is building the platform that captures, stores, and exposes the complete history of mission-critical OT (Operational Technology) asset access. Through event ingestion, audit logging, activity tracking, and data services, we provide the foundation for compliance and security reporting as well as AI-driven insights. Reliability, traceability, and data integrity are at the core of what we do.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Backend Engineer with a strong hybrid skill set across C#/.NET and Python to help us build the services that turn our audit and activity data into insight. Your main mission is to design and build the event-driven pipelines and backend services that sit on top of the audit platform: processing events as they arrive, enriching them with context, detecting meaningful patterns, and delivering the result to the people and systems that need to act on it.

You will work closely with colleagues in the Data & AI team to take analytical work from proof of concept into production. That means the plumbing that makes intelligence useful: pipelines triggered by platform events and completing inside a tight SLA, structured outputs stored in a schema that can evolve, APIs that expose those outputs cleanly, and delivery into customer tooling such as SIEM and collaboration platforms. Our data workflows run on Azure Databricks and our services run on Azure, and you will own significant parts of how these two worlds fit together.

This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of event-driven backend development, data engineering, and production operations. You will influence architecture across processing pipelines, detection logic, and integration interfaces.

We are looking for a self-driven and curious engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment. You value a healthy feedback culture, are open and approachable, and enjoy working closely with colleagues, ideally from the office, to solve problems together. You are focused, eager to learn, and motivated to continuously improve both our processes and your own work. You are comfortable navigating external constraints and can design robust solutions within those boundaries. You maintain a practical balance in documenting your work: thorough enough to ensure clarity and knowledge-sharing, yet efficient enough to avoid unnecessary overhead.

Beyond all that, this role is a fantastic chance to grow professionally, personally, and as part of a team that genuinely enjoys building great things together and having fun along the way.

**What You Will Do

****Event Processing & Pipelines

**

• Build event-driven pipelines in C# and Python that pick up audit events as they land, process them inside a time budget, and turn them into records the product and customer tooling can query

• Design processing that is correct under real-world conditions: retries, out-of-order delivery, poison messages, backpressure, and at-least-once semantics

• Decide how pipeline output is stored and versioned. Our audit data is append-only, so there is no going back and rewriting it. A schema decision here is closer to permanent than in most systems

• Take analytical work that has been proven in a notebook and make it a service that runs unattended: scheduling, retries, throughput, cost, and the monitoring that catches it when it stops being accurate

**Detection & Enrichment Services

**

• Build the backend that separates the handful of events worth investigating from the thousands that are routine: aggregation across sessions, users and devices, time windows, behavioral baselines, and risk scoring

• Keep the signal-to-noise ratio high enough that customers leave the feature switched on: deduplication, suppression, thresholding, and confidence scores that are honest about uncertainty

• Design a rules layer that customers can configure, without every new detection requiring a release

• Enrich raw events with the context that makes them actionable: severity, reasoning, and links back into the product

**APIs & Integration

**

• Design and build the C# APIs that carry this output to the three places it gets consumed: our own product UI, customer SIEM platforms, and downstream services

• Build integrations that deliver notifications and structured evidence into customer tooling (SIEM platforms, collaboration tools, downstream services)

• Design clean data contracts and event formats suitable for compliance, security, and analytics consumers

• Ensure APIs are robust, performant, and scale with growing event volumes

**Running What We Build

**

• Operate the services you build: monitoring, alerting, tracing, and incident response across Azure, Databricks, and our messaging layer

• Build the observability that tells us when output quality degrades, not just when a service is down

• Maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and safe deployment practices for the services you own

**What You Bring

****Required Qualifications

**

• Solid experience with C#/.NET backend development

• Working proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline work — you do not need to have been a Python-first engineer, but you should be productive in it

• Strong experience with event-driven and asynchronous systems — queues, event buses, or message brokers — and a clear understanding of their failure modes

• Experience designing and implementing ETL or data pipelines in a production environment

• Experience designing and building APIs (REST, and ideally streaming or event-driven interfaces)

• Experience with cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure Databricks) and with working across a Python data stack and a C#/.NET production environment

• Solid understanding of relational and/or distributed data stores, including schema design and evolution

• Experience building multi-tenant systems where data isolation is a correctness requirement — authorization enforced in the data access path rather than bolted on at the edge

• Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions)

• Strong sense of code quality, testing, and maintainability

**Nice to Have

****Experience with any of the following is a plus:

**Platform and engineering breadth

• Queuing technology (e.g., RabbitMQ)

• Data streaming architectures (Kafka, Event Hubs, change data capture)

• Kubernetes and container-based deployments (Docker, AKS)

• Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Bicep, Terraform)

• Workflow orchestration tools (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, Azure Data Factory)

• Azure services (Functions, Container Apps, Data Lake, API Management, Monitor / Log Analytics)

• Observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)

• Distributed systems failure modes and resilience patterns

• Append-only / immutable data stores and time-series databases

**Domain

**

• Familiarity with SOC tooling and concepts (SIEM integration, log forwarding, security event formats such as CEF/LEEF)

• Rules engines or customer-configurable detection logic

• Exposure to OT, ICS, or other mission-critical / regulated environments

• Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as NIS2, ISO 27001, or IEC 62443

**Machine learning and data science

**

• Working alongside data scientists or ML engineers to productionize models — packaging, serving, and versioning

• MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model registries, evaluation pipelines, confidence calibration, and drift detection (MLflow or similar)

• Databricks and PySpark, Delta Lake, or other lakehouse technologies

• Practical exposure to anomaly detection, behavioral baselining, or statistical/ML approaches to event data

• Applied use of LLMs in production systems — structured output, evaluation, and cost control

**Why Join Us

**You will be joining an ambitious and fast-growing team that is shaping how data and AI power our products. We move quickly, take ownership of what we build, and care about doing things well. This is a place where your work has visible impact, where your ideas are heard, and where you can grow alongside colleagues who genuinely enjoy solving hard problems together. Spirii is looking for an Engineering Manager!

If you are passionate about cutting-edge software development technologies, leading agile teams, the EV industry, and creating outstanding products, join Spirii’s fantastic growth journey to lead the way for a sustainable future.

The Job

Spirii develops and provides world-class charging products and digital solutions to customers with electric cars. Our Digital Development department is proud to drive a listen, learn, and lead culture that allows us to constantly improve our ways of working. As Engineering Manager, you lead 1-2 of our engineering teams of 6–12 engineers and are accountable for making it a high-performing team. You own the people, the health of the team and the soundness of its engineering. You do this through others: Tech Leads and Senior Engineers guide the technical work day-to-day, and you make sure good decisions get made, quality stays high, and the team keeps getting better.

Spirii is adopting agentic development as the way we build software. AI agents are becoming part of how our engineers design, code, test, review and operate systems. You'll make it real in your team, working with colleagues across engineering to shape how we do it.

You work very closely with a Product Manager and a Designer. Product owns what we build and why; you own how well the team delivers it. You report to the Head of Engineering.

What You Will Do

Lead and grow your people

• 
Own the full people cycle for your team: hiring, onboarding, one-on-ones, feedback, career development, performance reviews and handling underperformance early and fairly.

• 
Build a team where people trust each other, take ownership and do their best work at a sustainable pace.

• 
Help your engineers grow, including senior engineers stepping into technical leadership.

Own team performance

• 
Be accountable for the team's delivery, predictability and quality, and for how it improves over time.

• 
Define with Product what good looks like, and track it with evidence such as delivery flow, reliability, and team health, not gut feeling.

• 
Turn priorities into clear commitments, make trade-offs visible, and protect the team so committed work gets finished.

Lead the shift to agentic development in your team

• 
Make agentic development part of how your team works every day, moving beyond individual experiments to shared practice.

• 
Adapt how work flows through your team as agents take on more of the building. That includes how work is specified, how code is reviewed and how quality is assured.

• 
Apply shared practices for quality, security and data handling as they develop, and stay accountable for what your team ships.

• 
Work with colleagues across engineering on how we adopt agentic development. Bring your team's needs and feedback, and help test and roll out new tools and practices.

• 
Track what agentic development changes for your team's delivery and quality, and share what you learn with other teams.

Ensure sound engineering

• 
Be accountable for the quality of your team's engineering decisions, including architecture, security, operational readiness, observability and technical debt, while your Tech Lead and engineers lead the design work.

• 
Make sure what the team ships is tested, observable and ready to run in production, and that incidents lead to real learning.

• 
Work with other Engineering Managers and Tech Leads to keep our platform and practices coherent across teams.

Collaborate across Spirii

• 
Partner with Product, Design, other departments and external consultants to align priorities and resolve dependencies.

• 
Communicate clearly and early about progress, risks and trade-offs.

Who You Are

• 
You care about people and want to build teams that grow, thrive and deliver.

• 
You hold a high bar for quality and for yourself, and you take ownership of results.

• 
You're genuinely excited about AI as the new way to build software. You want to be ahead of the curve, and you're curious about where it goes next.

• 
You're technical enough to challenge a design, read an incident and spot risk, even if you're not writing production code day to day.

• 
You communicate clearly with engineers, product people and leadership alike.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate has relevant experience with development of digital cloud-based solutions in an agile start-up environment and can take the responsibility for leading a team of developers.

We further look for a candidate with the following experience and personal traits:

• 
Relevant technical graduate degree at minimum bachelor level (engineer).

• 
3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager with direct reports, including hiring, coaching and performance management.

• 
A background as a software engineer (backend or full-stack) building cloud-based solutions.

• 
Solid understanding of distributed systems, such as microservices and APIs, and what it takes to run them reliably in production.

• 
Experience improving engineering practices like automated testing, CI/CD, observability or incident management.

• 
Familiarity with DORA metrics or similar ways of measuring delivery.

• 
Experience making senior engineers and tech leads more effective, rather than doing their work for them.

It's an advantage if you have

• 
Experience leading a team's adoption of AI-assisted or agentic development, including changing practices, not just introducing tools.

• 
Experience with AWS and containerised workloads.

• 
Experience from eMobility products.

• 
Experience leading a team through organisational change.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work life balance.

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• 
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• 
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• 
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• 
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• 
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• 
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-mobility provider which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii was founded seven years ago as a company. Nevertheless, the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport- and energy systems.

**If you are ready to shape global regulatory strategies and help bring innovative vaccines to more patients worldwide, apply through our designated application platform. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.

We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups -locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most.

About the role

As a Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management, you will work closely with clients and colleagues to address complex challenges across the life sciences value chain. You will take ownership of your work and contribute to delivering solutions that create real, lasting impact. This is a Senior role designed to provide project and program leadership to deliver strategic technical solutions that address complex client issues in the Life Sciences industry. You will be handling implementation/migration projects and programs to achieve desired outcomes and ensure successful business growth. You will also seek new business opportunities to help BASE life science grow its presence within existing and new customers.

Additionally, you will contribute to internal initiatives and training to further strengthen BASE life science’s project and program management methodologies, approach, and tools.

You will lead teams consisting of multiple workstreams, which could include BASE/Infosys, external third party, or client stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in, project/program management and the ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.

Your responsibilities include:

• Developing responses to Requests for Proposals (RfPs), ensuring adequate planning for scope, timelines and budget

• Monitoring project/program status including milestones, risks, issues, budgets, etc.

• Acting as a delivery escalation point and proactively ensuring escalations are handled promptly with a clear action and communication plan.

• Creating and delivering tailored communication based on audience, i.e., executive level summaries for client stakeholders, or senior executives in BASE life science, status reports at a project or program-level at a suitable cadence for team members

• Intervening, when necessary, to ensure costs, timelines and quality are on track.

• Lead a cross-functional team to deliver projects/programs to the required scope, on time, within budget, and to the satisfaction of our life science industry stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders in the life science industry to understand their needs and translate them into executable plans for the project team.

• Develop plans, timelines, and budgets for projects/programs for which you are responsible.

• Track and report on project/program progress, identifying and mitigating risks as needed.

• Facilitate communication and collaboration between the project team, life science industry stakeholders, and other teams within BASE life science.

You bring:

• 5+ years of experience as a technical project/program manager within Regulatory, Clinical, Quality or other GxP areas in the life science industry.

• Successful track record of managing technically complex projects/programs such as software development, implementation of IT systems, data migrations, etc.

• Experience leading technical teams and delivering data driven projects/programs.

• Experience with project management tools such as JIRA, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project etc.

• Experience with Agile project management methodologies such as SAFe.

• Strong communication skills, both in writing, meetings and in presentations.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

Additionally, the ideal candidate has the following skills/certifications:

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

• Experience selling either projects or products to clients.

• Experience working with Veeva Vault, SalesForce or similar technologies.

• Experience working with AI professionally

This position is offered in Denmark and Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2015, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting company working exclusively in life sciences, built on a simple purpose: grow our people, and deliver real impact for our customers.

We don't think AI is a feature you bolt onto existing systems — we think it's the layer through which a life sciences company's strategy actually gets executed, end to end. Most of the industry is still proving AI can do one task at a time, function by function, pilot by pilot. We're building toward something bigger: AI that runs across clinical, regulatory, quality, and commercial work instead of stopping at the edges of a single application.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Spain, Switzerland, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and the US, we work with top-10 pharma and ambitious biotechs alike, and with technology partners including Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Google, AWS, Microsoft, and Amass — turning that belief into deployed, compliant, sellable solutions, not slideware.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact — grounded in five core values: team spirit, trust, openness, ambition, and execution.

• Ambition, encouraged through ownership and continuous learning.

• Execution — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice.

• Openness — your ideas are heard, challenged constructively, and supported as you grow.

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance.

• The opportunity to shape a practice, not just staff one.

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?
